source_interpretation.conclusion: All C workers return complete after the first terminal close-word parse error, even with a later open brace. Jim retains later missing state and returns incomplete.
C8.4/8.5/8.6 use first close brace; C9 uses nested/escaped braced-variable delimiters. Jim malformed variable forms leave the Script missing marker unchanged.

All C values return incomplete. Jim variable/dict/expression sugar consumes the original malformed tail without changing Script completeness marker. This does not make the variable readable or executable.
C8.4 lacks selected expansion syntax and encounters terminal extra-after-brace; C8.5+ and Jim continue to the unclosed expanded word.
C terminal backslash is complete; reached pending backslash-LF is incomplete. Jim records terminal backslash as missing, but separator/comment backslash-LF reaches complete EOF.
Exact original scalar-value observations retained per row; no raw byte or suffix-equivalence rule is inferred.
